text: Riskometer (transcribed from the factsheet's riskometer graphic, which is an image): HDFC Flexi Cap Fund scheme riskometer as of August 31, 2026 - The risk of the scheme is very high (Very High risk). Product labelling: suitable for investors seeking long term capital appreciation/income and investment predominantly in equity & equity related instruments.

Riskometer (transcribed from the leaflet's riskometer graphic, which is an image): HDFC Mid Cap Fund scheme riskometer as of May 31, 2026 - The risk of the scheme is very high (Very High risk). The risk of the benchmark NIFTY MIDCAP 150 (TRI) is also very high.

Riskometer (transcribed from the factsheet's riskometer graphic, which is an image): HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund scheme riskometer as of August 31, 2026 - The risk of the scheme is very high (Very High risk).

Riskometer (transcribed from the factsheet's riskometer graphic, which is an image): HDFC Liquid Fund scheme riskometer as on 31 August, 2026 - The risk of the scheme is low to moderate (Low to Moderate risk). Potential risk class: B-I (relatively low interest rate risk and moderate credit risk).
